mapper.select: SELECT user_id , email , password_hash , nickname , birth_date , phone , gender , address , agreed_terms , agreed_privacy , role , status , email_verified , created_at , updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT user_id , email , password_hash , nickname , birth_date , phone , gender , address , agreed_terms , agreed_privacy , role , status , email_verified , created_at , updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT token_id , user_id , token_hash , purpose , used_at , attempt_count , created_at , expires_at FROM user_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT token_id , user_id , token_hash , purpose , used_at , attempt_count , created_at , expires_at FROM user_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tokens SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 , used_at = IF(attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, used_at) WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND used_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_tokens SET used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND used_at IS NULL
UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE , status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE user_id = #{userId}
